title: Kiritani Haruka — Brought Together〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Phew... I'm in good form today. I even finished earlier than usual.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Alright, I'll take a shower...
And then I'll check through all the comments before lunch.)

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Anyway, one more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I need to use my hips more for this dance.
One, two, three, four! Five, six, seven, eight!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Minori's so focused...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And her dancing's improved since the other day. The more complex steps look smoother, and she seems much steadier...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to learn from her example.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I still have time, so I should keep going for a bit longer. I'll do another set...)
One hour later
Cafeteria

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The archived recording of that planning meeting we streamed the other day should be... Here it is.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, people posted a lot of requests in the comments.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Let's see... A quiz tournament, wake-up pranks, “Appealing Talk Show feat. MMJ”...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I'm seeing a lot of fun-sounding ideas.
But we probably won't be able to do them all...)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, are you working on something?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, Airi. I was just looking at the comments on that stream we did. People sent in a lot of fun ideas.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I saw them too.
You had everything from suggestions about singing to ideas straight out of a variety show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd like to try making use of some of these ideas for our next segment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We did that show stream the other day, so I think we could try something with more of a variety vibe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, a lot of people did ask us to do a talk show of some sort.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, what if we did this?
A few hours later
Bedroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I tried coming up with some ideas, Haruka.
“MMJ Relatable Moments Championship” is the segment we talked about in the cafeteria.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow, you came up with so many...
Thanks, Airi. You really are amazing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Variety shows are my wheelhouse after all.
Want me to keep going until I have a finalized segment?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You'd do that? Then, if you don't mind...
Oh, but feel free to ask me for help if you get stuck.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! Let's make it a good one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Lastly, I need to make sure that my hips don't cause my weight to shift around too much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'm done reflecting in my notebook for today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work, Minori.
Would you all like to take a break now?
I just made some herbal tea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku. That sounds lovely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here's your cup, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's sweet and has a nice aroma to it.
It's so soothing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. You've all been working very hard today, so I tried going for something that would help you all relax.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's always looking out for us.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't remember how many times I've been saved by Shizuku's kindness...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Minori motivates me to keep trying harder no matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(And Airi's incredibly dependable.
She's always there to lend a hand when I need it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that the four of us get to work together like this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Um, Minori, Airi, Shizuku?
Thanks for always being such amazing people.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess I just felt compelled to say that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you're the reasons why I'm here right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe!
Thank you as well!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you're always doing a wonderful job of pulling us in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, let's keep doing our best together.
The four of us will keep supporting each other through thick and thin.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Nod*
